title: Harvard vs Stanford
shortAnswer: Harvard (founded 1636) is the oldest US university with the largest endowment ($50B) and leads in law and medical school prestige. Stanford (founded 1885) dominates in technology and entrepreneurship — more venture capital has been raised by Stanford alumni than any other university.
verdict: Harvard for law, medicine, and political leadership. Stanford for tech entrepreneurship and Silicon Valley connections. Both are world #1 caliber institutions.

lines.hook: Harvard was 249 years old before Stanford existed. Stanford still caught up.
lines.tape: One school owns the old money and the old power. The other owns the future.
rounds: Harvard predates the United States by 140 years. Nobody in America is older.

Harvard Law sits at number one. Everyone else is arguing over second.
